record.paper_title: Open questions for operators related to rectangular Catalan combinatorics
record.original_question: For all positive integers m and n, prove the e-inclusions q^alpha e_{m-1,n}(x;q,1+r) <=_e e_{m,n}(x;q,1+r) and q^beta e_{m-1,n}(x;q,1+r) <=_e h_hat_{m,n}(x;q,1+r), where alpha and beta are the staircase-counting exponents used for the corresponding Schur and e-inclusions. Can these e-inclusions be explained combinatorially?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Work in the ring $\Lambda = \mathbb{Q}(q,t)\otimes \Lambda_{\mathbb{Q}}[x]$ of symmetric functions in variables $x = (x_1, x_2, \ldots)$ with coefficients involving the formal parameters $q, t$. For a symmetric function $f$, write $f \geq_e 0$ (resp. $f \geq_s 0$) to mean that $f$ expands with nonnegative coefficients in the elementary basis $\{e_\mu\}$ (resp. the Schur basis $\{s_\mu\}$), and write $g \leq_e f$ to mean $f - g \geq_e 0$.

For positive integers $m, n$ and a nonnegative integer $r$, let $e_{m,n}(x;q,t)$ and $\widehat{h}_{m,n}(x;q,t)$ denote the rectangular $(m,n)$-Catalan symmetric functions obtained by applying the natural $(m,n)$-analogues of the elementary and (modified) homogeneous operators from the elliptic Hall algebra to the constant symmetric function $1$, specialized as the second parameter takes the value $t = 1+r$. Define the staircase-counting exponents
$$\alpha = \alpha(m,n,r), \qquad \beta = \beta(m,n,r),$$
as the exponents of $q$ that appear in the corresponding Schur-inclusion conjectures relating $e_{m-1,n}$ to $e_{m,n}$ and to $\widehat{h}_{m,n}$ at $t = 1+r$ (these are the exponents which make the $q$-Schur inclusion lower bound sharp).

Prove that for all positive integers $m, n$ and all nonnegative integers $r$, the following $e$-inclusions hold in $\Lambda$:
$$q^{\alpha}\, e_{m-1,n}(x;q,1+r) \;\leq_e\; e_{m,n}(x;q,1+r),$$
$$q^{\beta}\, e_{m-1,n}(x;q,1+r) \;\leq_e\; \widehat{h}_{m,n}(x;q,1+r).$$
Furthermore, provide a combinatorial explanation of these $e$-inclusions (e.g., via an injection of combinatorial objects that witnesses the nonnegativity of the differences in the elementary basis).
artifact.category_tag: symmetric functions and rectangular Catalan combinatorics
artifact.status_search_result: The question is one of the open problems formulated in Bergeron's program on rectangular Catalan combinatorics (around 2016-2017). Subsequent surveys on symmetric functions and rectangular Catalan combinatorics (2021) continue to list e-positivity and e-inclusion statements at t = 1+r among the conjectural open problems, with no published proof located.

status_evidence.title: Open Questions for operators related to Rectangular Catalan Combinatorics
status_evidence.snippet: Formulates many open questions regarding Schur positivity, e-positivity, and inclusion properties of symmetric functions arising from elliptic Hall algebra operators.
status_evidence.claim: This is among the open questions formulated by Bergeron concerning e-inclusions for the rectangular Catalan symmetric functions at t = 1+r.

status_evidence.title: Symmetric Functions and Rectangular Catalan Combinatorics
status_evidence.snippet: Survey of the rectangular Catalan combinatorics program covering positivity and inclusion conjectures.
status_evidence.claim: A 2021 survey continues to discuss these inclusion conjectures as open.
